title.zh: SmartLingo Standard、Max 与人工智能媒体额度
title.en: SmartLingo Standard, Max, and AI media credits

purpose.zh: 将平台会员简化为含广告的免费 Standard 与固定期限 Max，并为图片、音频和视频生成建立独立的预付额度与 Stripe、SmartPay 双付款路径。
purpose.en: Simplify platform membership to ad-supported Standard and fixed-term Max, while adding a separate prepaid balance for image, audio, and video generation through Stripe and SmartPay.

zh: 新增 6 个月 $59 与年度 $99 Max 固定期限方案，以及 $10 / 1,000 个人工智能媒体额度包。
参照 Konectible 的信息层级提供会员状态、并列 Max 方案卡、额度带和展开式付款方式选择。
Stripe 卡或银行账户付款与 Polygon SmartPay 加密付款统一调用同一套服务端权益发放逻辑。
图片、音频和视频分别按 20、10、200 额度计费；失败生成自动退回已扣额度。
en: Add fixed-term Max offers at $59 for six months and $99 annually, plus a $10 pack of 1,000 AI media credits.
Use a Konectible-inspired hierarchy with member status, parallel Max cards, a credit band, and expandable payment choices.
Route Stripe card or bank payments and Polygon SmartPay crypto payments through the same server-side entitlement service.
Charge image, audio, and video generation at 20, 10, and 200 credits respectively, refunding a completed debit when generation fails.

zh: 公开订阅页、登录会员面板、分享媒体工作室、Stripe Webhook、SmartPay 管理与加密结账、平台订阅及额度数据。
en: Public pricing, the signed-in membership panel, Share Studio, the Stripe webhook, SmartPay administration and crypto checkout, and platform entitlement data.

zh: 新增幂等的结账意图、链上付款认领、额度账户和不可为负的额度流水表；Clerk 用户重键时同步迁移这些归属记录。
扩展 SmartPay5 商品白名单，使课程继续以学习语言为 secondId，而 Max 与额度商品严格使用 platform 范围。
将人工智能语音生成纳入统一的受审计网关，并避免额度不足或扣款前失败时产生错误退款。
补齐中文及其余十种界面语言的会员和加密结账文案。
en: Add idempotent checkout-intent, on-chain claim, credit-account, and non-negative credit-ledger tables, including Clerk-user rekey propagation.
Extend the SmartPay5 product allowlist so courses retain learning-language secondId values while Max and credit products require the platform scope.
Move AI speech generation behind the audited unified gateway and prevent false refunds when no debit completed.
Complete membership and crypto-checkout copy for Chinese and the other ten translated interface languages.

zh: 476 项自动化测试全部通过，包括合约虚拟机正反交易、支付与额度边界、12 种界面语言及 D1 重复迁移。
TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、敏感数据扫描、生产构建、D1 外键检查和四项共享站点门禁通过。
未执行真实 Stripe 收款或真实链上转账；这两项保留给站点所有者控制的钱包与付款凭证。
en: All 476 automated tests pass, including positive and negative contract-VM transactions, payment and credit boundaries, twelve interface languages, and repeatable D1 migration replay.
TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, sensitive-data scanning, production build, D1 foreign-key checks, and all four shared site gates pass.
No live Stripe charge or on-chain transfer was made; those remain controlled by the wallet and payment credentials of the site owner.

zh: 新版 SmartPay5 必须由合约所有者在管理员付款页重新部署，并确认六个价格规则后，新的 Max 与额度加密付款才会在生产结账中启用。
en: The contract owner must redeploy the revised SmartPay5 contract and confirm its six price rules in the payment admin before new Max and credit crypto checkout options become available in production.

zh: 课程的九个固定期限套餐保持独立；Standard 与 Max 只控制平台广告体验，人工智能媒体额度也独立于 Max 有效期。
en: The nine fixed-term course packages remain separate; Standard and Max govern only the platform ad experience, and AI media credits remain independent from the Max term.

rollback.zh: 回退至上一成功的 Cloudflare Worker；0185 仅新增表与用户重键触发器，保留为空闲数据结构，不删除付款或额度记录。
rollback.en: Roll back to the previous successful Cloudflare Worker; migration 0185 is additive, so its tables and rekey trigger remain inert without deleting payment or credit records.
